finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Presidential Library page dates the Bolshevik takeover to 25 October (7 November) 1917 (L44-L55). Its event is the only option matching the prompt’s named October Revolution: the February option is a different 1917 revolution and led to Nicholas II’s abdication (Romanov source L333); the Decembrists’ armed uprising was in 1825 (L44); emancipation reform was in 1861 (serfdom source L44-L54).
finalGroupBindings.locator: turn1view0 L40-L55; turn3view0 L44; turn5view0 L44-L54

finalGroupBindings.literal: Октябрьской революцией называют приход большевиков к власти осенью 1917 года. Название связано с датой события по действовавшему тогда юлианскому календарю.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The official source explicitly says the October Revolution was the Bolshevik seizure of power, dates it 25 October (7 November) 1917, and explains that the October name followed the Julian date after the calendar change (L44, L54-L56).

finalGroupBindings.literal: В ходе восстания Временное правительство было низложено, его министры арестованы.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The directed repair adds an event-specific outcome beyond the prompt and key: during the uprising the Provisional Government was deposed and its ministers arrested. This is stated in the retained full Presidential Library article at L50 and explains the concrete result of the Bolshevik takeover.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Февральская революция 1917 года привела к отречению Николая II.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The source says that during the February Revolution in 1917 Russia was declared a republic and Nicholas II and his brother abdicated (L333). This substantiates the note’s February-event and Nicholas-II claim.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Восстание декабристов — попытка государственного переворота в Российской империи в 1825 году.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The source describes the Decembrists’ 14 (26) December 1825 armed uprising on Senate Square in St Petersburg against autocracy (L44), supporting the date and event summarized in this note.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Крепостное право в России отменили реформой 1861 года.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Presidential Library dates Alexander II’s manifesto abolishing serfdom to 19 February (3 March) 1861 and says the documents granted peasants personal freedom (L44,L50-L54).
